title: ReAct Agents for Tool Use
abstract: ReAct combines reasoning and acting for tool use. It exposes a limitation in static prompting for interactive tasks.

title: Memory-Augmented Agent Improves ReAct
abstract: Memory-Augmented Agent builds on ReAct and improves long-horizon tool use by adding episodic memory. The challenge is retaining task state across steps.

title: AgentBench Evaluation Protocol
abstract: AgentBench compares ReAct and Memory-Augmented Agent on tool-use benchmarks. The protocol evaluates planning, execution, and recovery failures.
